prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent 2D game sprite atlas for a German Shepherd police dog, matching the supplied game character art.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its warm hand-painted cartoon palette, bold dark hand-inked outlines, simple readable shaded forms, slight paper-like paint texture, and gently elevated 3/4 game view. Do not draw the human.
Primary request: one consistent adult German Shepherd police dog, tan legs/chest/muzzle, dark charcoal brown saddle and face mask, erect triangular ears, long muzzle, bushy tail pointing back left, four canine legs, small plain dark navy collar. Alert calm expression, no teeth, no weapon, no text.
Layout: EXACTLY FIVE full-body dogs in SIX equal invisible cells, a 3-column x 2-row atlas. Reading order: TOP LEFT idle standing naturally on all four paws; TOP MIDDLE walk_0; TOP RIGHT walk_1; BOTTOM LEFT walk_2; BOTTOM MIDDLE walk_3; BOTTOM RIGHT COMPLETELY EMPTY transparent. No cell border, labels or checkerboard. Wide landscape canvas, each cell wider than tall enough to include tail and muzzle. Large clear transparent gaps around ALL subjects: fit the entire dog's visible silhouette inside the central 76% of each cell's width and height. Ground paws near 86% cell height, body length and head size constant across all five. Every dog faces RIGHT in exactly the same camera angle, shows near and far legs separately, consistent body/neck/head silhouette and coat markings, consistent spine height and shoulder-to-hip length.
Animation: four unique sequential anatomically believable quadruped WALK poses completing one seamless cycle, no running, no bouncing whole dog. walk_0 contact A: near front leg extended forward, near hind leg trailing; opposing far legs distinct. walk_1 passing A: near front supporting, near hind lifted bent moving forward under belly, far foreleg passing back. walk_2 contact B: opposite fore/hind placements to walk_0, near front back, near hind forward, far front forward. walk_3 passing B: opposite supporting/lifted legs to walk_1, near forepaw lifted forward under chest, near hind supporting. Four real different paw placements and joint bends, not four copies, not whole-body rotation or stretching. Stable head/body scale, subtle gait bob allowed but lowest supporting paw stays on the same ground baseline in each cell.
Lighting: warm upper-left, understated painted highlights, no baked cast shadow.
Background genuinely transparent alpha, including between legs. No scenery, floor, UI, icons, labels, watermark, leash or handler. Keep dog breed and all five silhouettes clear at 44 pixel visible height; limited tiny details.
